MEET RHO

One blob. Zero chill.

RHO is a glossy navy blob who showed up on the timeline one day and never left. Nobody hired him, nobody can fire him — he just stands there, hands on hips, loop glowing, daring the chart to do something.

The short version: RHO is the face of $RHO — a meme coin that runs on one idea: a small loop, repeated by enough people, becomes a big one. He doesn’t give financial advice. He barely gives advice at all. He just shows up.

Why a blob? Because a blob has no angles to hide behind. What you see is what you get — shiny, round, and completely unbothered by red candles.

  • THE LOOP

    The glowing ρ on his head. It never turns off — not in a dip, not at 3am, not ever. That’s the whole personality.

  • THE BELLY

    Orange, oversized, and stamped RHO — a walking logo he carries everywhere, including into every group chat you drop him in.

  • THE STANCE

    Hands on hips, boots planted. The pose of someone who has seen the timeline at its worst and decided to stay anyway.

  • THE JOB

    Be recognizable in half a second, in any feed, at any size. If you can spot him in a blur of avatars, he’s doing it right.
